description: Installation de 9 bornes de recharge électrique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Sarreguemines Confluences. The Communauté d'Agglomération Sarreguemines Confluences, as part of its Climate Plan and its sustainable mobility policy, has decided to promote electromobility by installing 9 electric charging stations on its territory. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Sarreguemines Confluences. The portal shows the English title as "Installation of 9 electric charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Sarreguemines Confluences. Its keywords include irve-57. The listing shows 2019-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
